tool_input.prompt:
Draw a DARK 2D ANIMATION CUTOUT. The character is assembled from just a few matte flat color masses with THIN ROUGH CHARCOAL EDGES. Use hard-edged simple drawn shadows, each material only two or three dark value steps. Use Hollow Knight's sparse rounded-shape economy; no all-over repeating patterns or comic-book detail. The mail is a dark patch with only a few joined tiny ring curls indicating its material. Tattered cloth and a few chipped edges add road wear. Somber and endearing inside the darkness. Keep this extremely graphic and spare, rather than painterly, realistic, clean clip-art or a comic illustration.

ONLY HAND-DRAWN 2D ART. A single full-body game character on a charcoal-black square canvas with a small painted ground shadow. No 3D render, model, sculpt, miniature, photograph, glossy shader or smooth surface-lighting gradients.

Mood-board direction: Hollow Knight's economical large-head/tiny-body silhouette and darkness; Diablo II's grim earthy palette and rough worn materials; only a trace of Castle Crashers squat posing, with none of its bright colors or comedy. Sacred-horror references supply soot black, bone gray and dried red. Solemn, lonely, road-worn and quietly uncanny, still cute in structure. Use few light accents against large quiet dark shapes. Never cheerful, polished or heroic.

Guarin is a household knight from the Royans/Isere lands in a story set in 1101. ENORMOUS full-face greathelm, tiny broad body, stubby arms and legs, small squat rounded boots; helmet about half the character's total height before foreshortening. Face and eyes completely concealed. Wear a plain dull dark-gray iron barrel greathelm: unadorned level circular lid, two plain vertical rivet strips, one narrow black visor slit and small round breathing holes. Dark ring-mail shirt and short sleeves, ragged muted dried-wine scarf/short cape and matching ragged waist cloth, brown belt with plain rectangular buckle, brown gloves, taupe/brown forearm and shin wraps, short brown boots. Straight double-edged arming sword in viewer-left hand, disk pommel, straight crossguard, straight blade directed down across the front toward lower-right. Elongated taupe wooden kite shield at viewer-right, dull iron rim and one narrow faded wine-red panel. The greathelm is the deliberate anachronism. The legs and arms have ONLY brown cloth wraps and plain gloves/boots: NO metal kneepads, joint disks, elbow guards, bracelets, cuffs or plate pieces. Helmet, sword and shield rim are the only solid metal objects; the shirt is plain dark ring mail. No extra helmet disks, hinges, ornament, armor, heraldry, garments or weapons.

Orthographic elevated isometric gameplay view facing diagonally lower-right. Very steep downward camera, 75 degrees above the ground: the camera is almost directly overhead: the LEVEL helmet lid occupies a broad, nearly circular area, the helmet front is a short strip below it; shoulders hidden, tiny body compressed beneath the lid, boots peek out close to it. The head does not tilt to fake the view. Draw the helmet, shield rim and boot tops coherently from above. Small complete silhouette, generous empty border, no writing or panels. Muted soot gray, muddy taupe, dark dried-wine cloth, sparse chalk-gray edges.
